turns.text: Hey Lloyd, I'm finalizing the metadata for the DeepInsightTheorem paper. The reviewer complained about the density metric.

It's currently averaging 4.2 core techniques per proof. We need to stick to that for the submission.
Noted. I'll make sure the form reflects 4.2.
Thanks. Also, did you see that bug in the login module? It's still crashing on Chrome 120.
I saw the ticket. I've flagged it for the priority queue.
Lloyd, quick update on the theorem stats. We ran a new analysis pass and the density dropped.
DeepInsightTheorem has an average of 3.6 core techniques per proof now. We need to update the dashboard.
